name: barcode
title: Barcode
description: Scannable Code 128 and EAN-13 barcodes as SVG for tickets, labels and packing slips, with the check digit handled and the value in text below.
docs: Code 128 takes any ASCII text and chooses its own code sets; EAN-13 takes twelve digits (the check digit is added) or thirteen (it is checked), and a value that cannot be encoded is reported in words instead of drawn. The quiet zone and black on white are fixed because a scanner needs them. encodeBarcode and eanCheckDigit are exported for validating a value before you print it.
